name: model-routing
description: Model-routing rules for coding agents. Splits work into steps and gives each step a model and effort (GPT-6 Luna, Terra 6.1, Sol 6.1, Astra, Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5) based on whether its output can be checked, with evidence from independent benchmarks. Excludes Fable and Gemini.
